result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both forms are close. Each uses visible labels, selects for time and length, and steppers for the kayak counts. B wins because its numbered sections (When, Your boats, Who's booking) group the fields more clearly, and it visibly collects contact details, which you need to hold a booking. Neither screenshot shows the submit button, a running total or required/optional markers above the fold. A's live '0 of 6 people' counter is a nice touch, but within the cropped view it has no contact section at all. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): The two forms are very similar: both use clear persistent labels, selects for departure time and rental length, and steppers for single and tandem kayaks, all with system fonts and nothing clipped. B pulls slightly ahead because it shows a live '0 of 6 people' counter and lists prices at the top, and a total panel appears to begin at the bottom of its screenshot. A has cleaner numbered groups (When, Your boats, Who's booking). Neither screenshot shows the submit button or required/optional markers, so those scores are uncertain.
